تقتطعي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَطِعِي (taqtaṭiʕī) /taq.ta.tˤi.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# تُقْتَطَعِي (tuqtaṭaʕī) /tuq.ta.tˤa.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
